text:
Maria G: Heads-up — PR #412 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is ready for review. Netlify preview queued but Assets tab shows fonts.css 404. Planning to merge in the Tue maintenance window 2026-03-27 01:00 UTC unless anyone flags a blocker. Can reviewers + infra confirm preview/CI?

Kevin L: I can take review tonight. Which preview URL? I hit the same fonts 404 yesterday on a different PR.

Deploy Bot: [auto] Netlify deploy queued for PR #412 — deploy id 12345-abc — status: failed (asset 404).

docs-bot: Docs CI — markdown lint: pass. linkcheck: 2 broken external links (see checks).

Sam T: Local repro steps that helped me:
```
git checkout pr/412
pipenv install --dev
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
```
If fonts return 404 locally, run a static serve to verify built assets:
```
mkdocs build
python -m http.server --directory site 8000
```
Also double-check `mkdocs.yml` extra_css/extra_javascript paths (common culprit).

Alex P: Quick pragmatic fix — copy fonts into `/docs/assets/fonts` and reference them from `/assets/fonts/...`. We did a similar copy for PR #398 and Netlify stopped 404ing.

Maria G: :thumbsup: I'll try copy-and-redeploy now. If that fixes it, can we still target the maintenance merge slot? We have a light canary window at 01:00-02:00 UTC.

Jen R: If deploy keeps flaking, prefer to merge with a `docs:hotfix` tag and follow up with a cleanup PR. Also we need 2 reviewer approvals before merging.

Kevin L: Requested a tiny rename in the SDK snippet (var -> client). I'll re-check after the redeploy.

Maria G: Pushed branch `fix/fonts-rebase` with the copy, redeploying. New preview link will be posted when ready.

Deploy Bot: [auto] Deploy finished — preview up: https://deploy-preview-412--redwood-docs.netlify.app — status: success.

Sam T: Local checklist (added to docs PR comment):
1) `mkdocs serve` and sanity-check CSS/fonts
2) `mkdocs build` + `python -m http.server --directory site 8000` to mirror Netlify static output
3) run linkcheck (we use `linkchecker` or `markdown-link-check`)
4) smoke test SDK snippets (copy/paste into REPL)

Code snippet I pasted for step 2: ```bash
mkdocs build && python -m http.server --directory site 8000
```

Alex P: From infra side LGTM, no perf or pathing concerns.

Kevin L: Approved. :white_check_mark: Made the small var rename.

Maria G: Thanks — scheduling merge for 2026-03-27 01:00 UTC maintenance window. Leaving PR open for another hour for last QA.

Jen R: Noted. Please add release note: "Fix: font asset path in migration guide" in the PR description.

Maria G: Added release note and the local checklist to the PR. Will merge after maintenance window unless anything else pops up. Closing thread after merge.
